overview.purpose_zh: 这张图把每个月注册的一批用户排成一行，横向看他们在注册后的第 1、2、3……个月还有多少人留在产品里，用来看留存随时间怎么衰减。
works_zh: 适合看新用户流失集中在头几个月
适合比较不同注册批次在相同月龄的留存
适合判断产品改动有没有让新批次留得更久
uses_zh: 向投资人解释用户质量

understanding.read_zh: 先看最上面一行 2026-01，它从 1,240 一路降到 322；再看每一行从第 0 列到第 1 列的落差，那是流失最快的一段；最后注意越往下行越短，因为新批次还没有攒够同样长的观察时间。空白格子表示“还没到那个月”，不是用户没了。

elements.note_zh: 每一行是一个注册月份，从上到下按时间排列。
每一列是注册之后的第几个月，第 0 列就是注册当月。
格子里的数字是这一批用户里仍然活跃的人数，颜色越深人数越多。
每一批注册时的总人数，也是计算留存比例的分母。

look_for_zh: 每一行第 0 列到第 1 列的落差，这是所有批次共同的最大流失段。
行末的格子：越往下越靠左结束，空白代表还没到那个月。
同一列上不同批次的数字是否接近，接近说明留存形状稳定。

observations.en: January starts with 1,240 active users and falls to 322 by month 6, so about a quarter of the cohort is still active.
observations.zh: 一月批次从 1,240 名活跃用户开始，到第 6 个月只剩 322 人，大约四分之一还在用。

observations.en: The first month is the steepest drop: January loses 533 users between month 0 and month 1.
observations.zh: 第一个月跌得最狠：一月批次在第 0 到第 1 个月之间少了 533 人。

observations.en: Later rows are shorter: May runs from month 0 to month 2, while January reaches month 6.
observations.zh: 越往下行越短：五月批次只记录到第 2 个月，一月批次则到第 6 个月。

observations.en: At month 2, every cohort sits between 540 and 640 active users, so the shape repeats across signup months.
observations.zh: 到第 2 个月，每一批都落在 540 到 640 名活跃用户之间，说明各注册月份的留存形状相当一致。

observations.en: May is the largest cohort at 1,400 signups, and 640 of those users are still active at month 2.
observations.zh: 五月是最大的一批，有 1,400 人注册，其中 640 人在第 2 个月仍然活跃。

observations.en: At month 3, March leads with 486 active users, just ahead of January and April at 470.
observations.zh: 到第 3 个月，三月批次以 486 人领先，一月和四月以 470 人紧随其后。

describe.en: The cohort chart shows how many users from each monthly signup group were still active in the months after they joined.
describe.zh: 这张同期群图展示每个月注册的一批用户，在注册之后的各个月份还有多少人仍然活跃。
describe.pattern: The chart shows how many + group + still active + after + event
alternatives: The chart tracks five signup cohorts over their first months in the product.
This cohort view lays out retention by signup month and month since signup.
describe.note_zh: 开头要把两个时间维度说清楚：哪个月注册，以及注册后过了几个月。

describe.en: January falls from 1,240 active users at month 0 to 707 at month 1 and 322 at month 6.
describe.zh: 一月批次从第 0 个月的 1,240 名活跃用户，降到第 1 个月的 707 人，再到第 6 个月的 322 人。
describe.pattern: X falls from + starting value + to + ending value
alternatives: January drops from 1,240 to 707 in the first month alone.
The January row declines from 1,240 at signup to 322 by month 6.
describe.note_zh: fall 的过去式是 fell；这里用一般现在时描述图上的走势，整段时态保持一致。

describe.en: No cohort increases to its original size again; even May, which starts at 1,400, is down to 640 by month 2.
describe.zh: 没有哪一批能回升到最初的规模；即便是从 1,400 人开始的五月批次，到第 2 个月也只剩 640 人。
describe.pattern: No cohort + verb + to + level; even X is down to + level
alternatives: Every cohort shrinks; May goes from 1,400 at month 0 to 640 at month 2.
None of the groups returns to its starting size.
describe.note_zh: 这里借用 increase to 的对比结构，先说不存在回升，再用 even 举最强的反例。

describe.en: The retention pattern remains stable across cohorts: at month 2, every group sits between 540 and 640 active users.
describe.zh: 各批次的留存形状保持稳定：到第 2 个月，每一组都在 540 到 640 名活跃用户之间。
describe.pattern: remain stable + across + group; at + period, every group + verb
alternatives: The shape of the decline holds steady from one signup month to the next.
At month 2, the cohorts are closely grouped, from 540 to 640.
describe.note_zh: remain stable 说的是形状和水平基本不变，允许小范围差异，不要求每个数完全一样。

describe.en: At month 3, March is higher than every other cohort, with 486 active users against 470 in January and April.
describe.zh: 到第 3 个月，三月批次高于其他所有批次，有 486 名活跃用户，一月和四月则是 470 人。
describe.pattern: A + be + higher than + B + with + figure + against + figure
alternatives: March leads at month 3 with 486, just ahead of January and April at 470.
March holds 486 users at month 3, more than February's 450.
describe.note_zh: higher than 后面可以直接跟数字，也可以用 against 把两边的数并排放。

describe.en: What stands out is how much of the loss happens in the first month and how little the later months add to it.
describe.zh: 最突出的是：绝大部分流失发生在第一个月，后面几个月的下降幅度小得多。
describe.pattern: What stands out is how much + clause + and how little + clause
alternatives: What stands out is the steep first-month drop followed by a much flatter tail.
The most striking feature is the sharp fall between month 0 and month 1.
describe.note_zh: what stands out 适合放在一段观察的开头，后面接 how + 形容词，把注意力引到形状上。

academic.en: The chart follows five monthly signup cohorts over the period for which each has been observed. January is the only cohort with a six-month history; its active users fall from 1,240 at month 0 to 707 at month 1 and to 322 at month 6. The first interval is consistently the steepest: February drops from 1,180 to 690, and March from 1,320 to 760. After month 1 the decline flattens, with every cohort at month 2 lying between 540 and 640 active users. May, the largest cohort at 1,400 signups, still records 640 users at month 2.
academic.zh: 这张图追踪五个按注册月份划分的用户群，观察时长以各组已有的数据为准。一月是唯一有六个月历史的组，活跃用户从 0 月的 1,240 人降到 1 月的 707 人，再到 6 月的 322 人。第一个月总是下降最陡：二月从 1,180 降到 690，三月从 1,320 降到 760。过了 1 月之后，降幅变缓，所有组在 2 月的活跃用户都在 540 到 640 之间。五月是规模最大的一组，有 1,400 人注册，2 月仍有 640 名用户。

business.en: Our chart gives us a clear message: most churn happens in month 1, not later. January keeps only 707 of its 1,240 users after that first month, then falls far more gently to 322 by month 6. We see the same pattern in every cohort, and at month 2 each group sits between 540 and 640 active users. May, our biggest cohort at 1,400 signups, still holds 640 at month 2. We should spend our onboarding budget on the first four weeks rather than late win-back campaigns, and we should only compare users in the same month since signup, because shorter rows on newer cohorts mean missing history, not lost users.
business.zh: 这张图给我们的信息很明确：大部分流失发生在 1 月，而不是更晚。一月在第一个月之后只剩 707 人，随后下降平缓得多，到 6 月为 322 人。各组都是同样的形态，2 月时每组的活跃用户都在 540 到 640 之间。五月是最大的一组，有 1,400 人注册，2 月仍有 640 人。我们应把新手引导预算花在前四周，而不是后期的召回活动；比较时只能用注册后同一个月份的数据，因为新组的短线是缺少历史数据，不是用户流失。

simple.en: Each row is one signup month. Each column shows how many months passed since those people joined. January starts with 1,240 users and ends at 322 after six months, so most of the drop happens early. The first month is the hardest. Only 707 users remain from January, and February keeps 690 out of 1,180. Newer rows are shorter because those people have not been here as long. May had 1,400 signups and still has 640 users after two months.
simple.zh: 每一行是一个注册月份。每一列表示这些人加入后过了几个月。一月从 1,240 人开始，六个月后只剩 322 人，所以大部分下降都发生在前面。第一个月最难熬：一月只剩 707 人，二月的 1,180 人只剩 690 人。越新的组行数越短，因为那些人加入的时间还不够长。五月有 1,400 人注册，两个月后还有 640 人。

language_notes.body_zh: 图里的格子是活跃人数，不是留存率。要说比例，用 322 out of 1,240 或 a quarter of the cohort；out of 比 from 更自然。retention rate 后面要跟 at month 6 这类时间点，否则读者不知道是哪一期的留存。
examples: 322 of January's 1,240 users were still active at month 6.
January retained about a quarter of its users after six months.

language_notes.body_zh: 第 0 列是注册当月，不是“第一个月”。the first month 通常指 month 1；写 since signup 或 after signup 才不会让人误会。说“第一个月流失最多”时，最好把 month 0 和 month 1 两个端点都写出来。
examples: Month 0 is the signup month, when all 1,240 users are active.
By month 1, January has fallen to 707.

language_notes.body_zh: 列是可数的，用 fewer columns；历史或时间不可数，用 less history。不要把 fewer 和 less 对调。fewer 后面接复数名词，less 后面接不可数名词。
examples: May has fewer columns than January.
The newer cohorts have less history to show.
